citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 10:26AM on
8/31/2026. The inspector attempted to contact the authorized person by leaving a voicemail on C. Stoutz phone at
10:24am, 10:26am and 11:21am. Sent a text message to C. Stoutz at 10:28am. Contacted E. Stoutz by phone at
10:27am, and he called C. several times with no answer. Left Attempted Inspection Flyer on Amazon box by front door.
Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations.
Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
Additional Inspectors:
Sarah RoloffEnd Section
